choice_data_list: You look like you got some proper rest!
You look like you got some proper rest!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It seemed like
a lot of people were out yesterday."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whether in the cafeteria or the washroom,
stopped by no one, bothered by nothing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: If only things were always like that, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Setting the reasons aside—I hope she continues to enjoy peaceful times ahead. Seeing her somewhat serene expression, that was what I thought.
